title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
What the live paper record shows is the engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. Every position in this record is paper, and no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. One trade says nothing about a strategy, and the record is unproven until it has more history.

## Paper framing and scope

Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were more common than wins and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The record is paper, so these outcomes are signals and measurements rather than filled trades.

## Open positions

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 1 position open on paper: HYPEUSDT since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z. Separately, a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. The only open position in the listed live record is therefore HYPEUSDT, while htf-rsi-v007 and trend-daily-v005 show no open positions. No open position means no current paper exposure for that engine. This is the current state of the paper record, not a claim about future entries.

## Closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 has closed 4 trades so far, with average null net per trade. The average is reported as null, so no net figure is available for those 4 trades. trend-daily-v005 has closed 5 trades so far, with average -13.68% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has closed 5 trades so far, with average -13.68% net per trade. The ATOM trade is a closed trade in this record: entry at 2.066, exit at 1.703, and result −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The exit occurred below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close. NEAR at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 remains open, so it is not included in the closed-trade averages. In testing, losses were more common than wins and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## Market filter and breakout distances

The Bitcoin market filter is on for trend-daily-v005. The Bitcoin market filter is on for trend-daily-v006. With the filter on, trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper and trend-daily-v006 has 1 position open on paper. The filter is reported as on; the record does not say why. The closest distances to a 20-day breakout are:

- For trend-daily-v005, UNIUSDT is 3.15% below its high.
- For trend-daily-v005, XRPUSDT is 6.50% below its high.
- For trend-daily-v005, BCHUSDT is 7.26% below its high.

These measurements show how far each listed symbol is from its 20-day high. None of the listed distances is 0, and the record does not say that any of these symbols has reached a 20-day breakout. Breakout distances are measurements from the running record, not forecasts.

## Where to check and how to read it

This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-04T14:24:46.196Z. Because the record updates continuously, the open positions, closed trades, and filter state can change after this snapshot. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record is paper only, unproven, and inconclusive at this size. One trade says nothing about a strategy.
